title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Dragonfruit Peach Melon Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Dragonfruit Peach Melon combines three juicy tropical fruits in a bright and exotic vape. Smooth, mellow Peach forms the base, lifted by the subtly sweet, slightly creamy flavour of Dragonfruit. Juicy Melon adds a soft, fresh top note to complete this vibrant and easy-going blend. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, designed for use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Together, they deliver up to 6000 puffs (depending on usage) of rich flavour and satisfying vapour. The pods use dual mesh coil technology for a consistently smooth draw and excellent flavour clarity. With an automatic refill system and leak-resistant pod design, the device is both simple to use and easy to maintain. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, this pod delivers a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and fast-absorbing nicotine, ideal for MTL vaping. Replace the pod and refill container as needed for uninterrupted flavour.
